fields.Dialogue Text: She started having me lay back and get comfortable, as she gently explored and stroked around my down… She said the feathers were so soft down there…
It was a really special night… And I owe her a lot to help me come out of my shell…
I’ll never forget how her little curious paws felt… Seeing her cute lil’ excited face as she explored…
As I began to relax, she started to work her way inside, and GOSH~! She really knows how to please a lady, bahaw!
Hey, I see my message found you…
So what’s the plan this time?
I’d like to return the favor.
How about you fool around in me and we’ll see where it goes from there?
Great! Climb on top lil’ guy, show me what you got!
Been a while since I’ve been on the receiving end…
Aw, but now you’re slipping out!
Yeah but it feels so gooooood.
But uh… Do squeeze when I’m gonna cum…
Well in that case… Time to squeeze!
Y’know, you look pretty cute next to my meat.
How about you give it some attention?
Big ole hunkin’ thing like this? Of course I’ll be giving it some attention!
Heh, hard to imagine this thing was inside ya, eh?
No worries, now it’s time for my revenge!
You won’t be able to walk straight for a week!
Ok big guy, how about you put that mouth to work?
Lap up that pre while you’re at it…
Big ole guy like you sensitive to a lil tongue like mine?
Hah, yeah I’ve got a soft spot for little cuties.
Alright, I’m about to lose it.
Think you can wrap your mouth around me?
Gah, that’s it. Gulp it down…
Mmm yeah that was good… Aside from the mess you made…
Yeah but it’s partly your mess, so I figured we could clean it together…
You’ve got a silver tongue on ya. In more ways than one!
Get up here and let me taste it…
The two finish up and cuddle for a bit before separating ways.
Rascal ducks down under the counter…
Maaaaavieeee~! We’ve got some <wiggle a=0.075 f=2.5>shmekels</wiggle> for ya!
Just a couple things! Some claw clippers, floss, a spatula, cooking oil-
No, something’s up… I can <speed=0.25>smell it… <waitfor=0.5><speed=1>Is Rascal here?
Right before you guys came in! I keep telling him he’s gotta take a shower! <color=#838383>He’s a really stinky pan-!</color>
*Next scene where rascal is sucking him off*
<speed=0.25>And this… <wave a=0.1 f=3>“shlucking”</wave> sound I’m hearing…?
<speed=0.1>Uh… <speed=1>O-old pipes y’know… <waitfor=0.5>Sprung a leak in the back… <waitfor=0.5>it’s a… <waitfor=0.5><size=10><color=#838383>mmmnggg…</color> <size=16>It’s a mess…
*Next illustration, rascal face full of dong*
And this new smell… Like… hmm… <waitfor=0.5>Help me out here Claire…
<speed=0.25>Well . . . <waitfor=0.5><speed=0.75>I guess in that case I’ll carry on with my order.
Let’s remove the last things on the list.
Now I’m just looking for something <size=18><speed=0.25>thick and hard . . .
Ok that’s it, I’m going back there.
N-no! This area is employees only!
I see we just missed the show…
Oh he can go again. Maverick’s a marathon man.
No, no, everyone out of the counter. I have to clean this up before anyone else—
My back’s been acting up again… I was wondering if ya had any of those herbs?
… I’m gonna keep messing with him…
Oh don’t worry, Bucky’s kinda hard of hearing. If we keep our voice down—
Maverick, thats my bad ear, speak at this one!
The herbs, yes they are just over—
*animate up the hand with the herbs, like, slide it upward over a second or two.
<color=#838383>You think you can just get a free show?
Wow did you just… <waitfor=0.75>cum from making a sale?
That’s such a big step for you! I told ya it makes the work day better!
Ok, so what do I owe ya for all this?
Well great! I’m going to leave before you change your mind!
Also heh… <waitfor=0.5>I like your new tails!
Maverick looks under the counter to see a mess of critters and spunk. The coyotes are hungrily lapping away at Rascal.
OK LADIES. If you want to be employees so badly, you must pass the interview!
But I didn’t bring my resume!
Rascal, you’re being promoted to Manager’s Assistant.
I need your help with the routine cookie inspection!
Maybe attached to a pair of big <waitfor=0.5><size=18>fluffy <waitfor=0.5><size=24>NUTS-
No, I need a new ice pack… my previous one sprung a leak and…
Oh no, Claire… <shake a=0.3>we haven’t shaved…</shake>
Throughout the night, mice swap partners, positions, and fluids.
The mice lose themselves in a tangle of paws and tails.
And of course, they shower their warrior with just as much love and affection.
As Rascal places the jar near the stump, two elder female mice approach him, their bodies adorned from head to paw with intricate tattoos. They gesture for Rascal to lie down.

One mouse working on Rascal’s thighs trail off, settling between his legs. They explore his sheath and move down to his balls. The mouse strokes them lovingly for just a moment, before one of the elders scolds them.

When he lowers his head, the mice gently place leaves over his eyes. With his vision obscured, Rascal focuses on the sounds around him. The pitter-patter of tiny paws fills the air, growing louder as more mice join in.
As the leaves are lifted from Rascal's eyes, he looks down and sees intricate swirls and shapes perfectly mirrored across his body. Nearby, a few mice beam with pride at their handiwork.
A floral aroma pierces Rascal's nostrils as the mice begin grinding something. One of the elders barks out commands, and the air fills with citrus and a trace of mint.
“Thank you!” Rascal says, while one of the mice leads him toward the campfire. More mice gather around, watching intently as the elders take turns tossing various items into the fire.
Small paws move methodically over Rascal's body, tracing bold strokes and intricate swirls. The mice work in perfect harmony.
Across the clearing, the stump housing Mabel glows with a steady rhythm, each pulse casting vibrant light. With every burst of color, the campfire’s flames respond in unison.
The elder mice's chants become louder! Pink flames and streaks explode out from the campfire! As this happens, the group of mice pair off and begin kissing.
The flames die down as the ritual comes to an end. Exhausted and dripping mice motion for Rascal to follow them to a nearby creek.
Two mice climb on Rascal and begin exploring his snout. “I’ll just follow their lead” thinks Rascal, as they smooch around his lips. He lightly caresses the mice and brings them in closer.
They wash up and return to the campfire...

The three take turns making out and exploring each other. Rascal gets bolder with his tongue, and the mice reflect his energy. And then, the trees alight with a brilliant red. And the ritual begins...
